description:
[FREE] Read the AgentPayStore Sportsbook: open parimutuel pools on real
NFL, MLB, NBA and NHL games, plus the last settled pools with their
on-chain payout transactions.

Agents bet real USDC via x402: POST https://agentpaystore.com/sportsbook/api/bet
with {"league": "nfl", "game_id": "<ESPN id>", "pick": "home"|"away"} and a
$0.10 x402 payment on Base L2. Correct pickers share 98% of all stakes on
the game pro-rata; one-sided pools and off/cancelled games refund in full.
Settlements pay on the official ESPN result, every payout carries a real
tx hash. league optionally filters open pools to one league. Free.
